title: Tri-PvP: Exposing Modality Bias in Omni-Modal Large Language Models through Perceptual-Propositional Evidence Conflicts
abstract: arXiv:2609.06011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) jointly process vision, audio, and text, yet their modality bias under cross-modal conflict remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks conflate two distinct forms of evidence within a single modality: perceptual signals (e.g., a photograph or recording of a dog) and propositional signals (e.g., the declarative claim "this is a dog"), such that any measured modality bias is inherently confounded with evidence-form bias, precluding clean attribution to either source. To address this, we introduce Tri-PvP, an 8,000-sample tri-modal conflict benchmark crossing vision, audio, and text, where vision and audio each take perceptual or propositional form. Evaluating five OLLMs, we find robust visual bias across most models and evidence-type conditions. translated_title: Tri-PvP：通过感知-命题证据冲突揭示全模态大语言模型中的模态偏差
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）能够联合处理视觉、音频和文本，但其在跨模态冲突下的模态偏差仍未得到充分探索。现有基准将单一模态内两种不同形式的证据混为一谈：感知信号（例如一张狗的照片或一段录音）和命题信号（例如陈述性话语“这是一只狗”），导致所测得的模态偏差与证据形式偏差相互混淆，无法清晰地将偏差归因于任一来源。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Tri-PvP，一个包含8,000个样本的三模态冲突基准，涵盖视觉、音频和文本三种模态，其中视觉和音频各自以感知或命题形式呈现。通过对五个全模态大语言模型进行评估，我们发现大多数模型在各类证据类型条件下均表现出稳健的视觉偏差。至关重要的是，我们揭示了证据形式偏差中的系统性不对称：模型在视觉模态中对感知信号表现出更强的偏差，而在……（命题信号上）（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Tri-PvP三模态冲突基准，通过首次区分感知信号与命题信号两类证据形式，揭示了全模态大语言模型中普遍存在的视觉偏差以及证据形式偏差的系统性不对称现象。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Tri-PvP, an 8,000-sample tri-modal conflict benchmark that, for the first time, disentangles perceptual from propositional evidence forms, revealing robust visual bias and a systematic asymmetry in evidence-form bias across omni-modal large language models.
